name: Coalition Market
desc:
With great efforts, infighting, plenty of stolen research, numerous deaths unaccounted for, a market was finally established.
Though each faction is looking out for themselves, it was agreed that all Coalition established items would be sold in a cental location outside of faction control. 
The Coalition profits in an unwinnable war against the United Federation of Planets. Coalition established items can be found here.
